verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI code-review service, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a hosted GitHub app and dashboard, plus a local CLI that reviews uncommitted changes; that CLI is a client tool, not a self-hosted deployment of the core product. No documentation shows that cubic's review service can be deployed on user-controlled infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
